claim_en: THE FOUR-TOKEN LITURGY. Rest, zikhronot, shofarot, the day; malkhuyot adjoined; the order dispute with Usha; Onkelos's broken cry.
middah: plain (the four-token liturgy — rest, remembrances, horn blasts, the day, each token a liturgical job; kingships adjoined; the order dispute with Usha; the received translation's broken cry, ink, beside)

claim_en: THE SHOFAR. Instrument, plain blasts, three-of-three, all from the Jubilee.
middah: I2 (the shofar's instrument, plain blasts, three of three all carried from the Jubilee on the shared 'seventh month')

claim_en: THE DAY ATONES. Without rites or offerings; only the penitent by 'but'; warning and punishment for work.
middah: plain (the day atones without rites or offerings; only the penitent by the restrictive 'but', E2, beside; warning and punishment for work; the received translation of 23:27 the ink leg)

claim_en: KARET IS DESTRUCTION. The effect's content; the five afflictions; not the weekly Sabbath.
middah: M-09 (excision is destruction — the verse's own 'I will destroy' as the effect's content; the five afflictions; not the weekly Sabbath; the received translation of 23:30 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE ADDITION. Profane to holy on every rest; no karet or warning on it; the fast's warning from a redundant punishment.
middah: plain (the addition — profane to holy on every rest; no excision or warning on it; the fast's warning from a redundant punishment; the received translation of 23:32 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE FIRST SEVEN. Sukkah for Sukkot only; chagigah for God, sukkah for man; sanctify with food, drink, clothing.
middah: plain (the first seven — the booth for the Feast of Booths only; the festival offering for God, the booth for man; sanctify with food, drink, clothing; the received translation of 23:34 the ink leg)

source: Sifra, Emor, Section 12 5-10 + Chapter 15 1-5 + Onkelos Lev 23:36
claim_en: THE INTERMEDIATE DAYS. Work bounded by 'it'; the order rule with invalidity; the do-not-delay timer after three festivals in order.
middah: E2 ('it' bounds the work ban to the day itself — the intermediate days; the order rule with invalidity; the do-not-delay timer after three festivals in order; the received translation of 23:36 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE INGATHERING. Intercalate for the ingathering of most fruits; make-up all seven.
middah: plain (the ingathering — intercalate for the ingathering of most fruits; make up all seven; the received translation of 23:39 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE FOUR SPECIES. Bound disputed; yours not stolen (the ship); day, first day even Sabbath; the identifications and counts; whole taking; Onkelos naming them.
middah: plain (the four species — bound disputed; yours not stolen, the ship, E2, beside; the first day even on the Sabbath; the identifications and counts; whole taking; the received translation naming them, ink)

claim_en: THE CHAGIGAH. One day with seven-day make-up, inside the season only.
middah: plain (the festival offering — one day with a seven-day make-up, inside the season only; the received translation of 23:41 the ink leg)

claim_en: THE SUKKAH. Dwell as you live; nights by the Lev 8 analogy; women out, minors in; any material by the strict-to-lenient meta-rule; Onkelos rules clouds.
middah: M-09 ('dwell' as you live — the keyword; nights by the Lev 8 analogy on the shared 'seven days', I2, beside; women out, minors in; any material by the strict-to-lenient meta-rule; the received translation rules clouds, ink)

claim_en: MOSES TAUGHT. Each festival's laws in its season; the season fixed for all public offerings; Onkelos's 'order... and taught.'
middah: plain (Moses taught — each festival's laws in its season; the season fixed for all public offerings; the received translation's 'order... and taught', ink, beside)
